power_contract: Energy=2^Power; reach=3.5*2^(Power-1) cells for registered level pieces.

families.name: PixelwoodA_PostLantern
families.note: Square amber lantern, dark corner mullions, broad hipped cap and squared foot. Three source pixels per voxel.

families.name: PixelwoodB_Campfire
families.note: Five GIF frames reviewed. Static flame inspired by frame 0; eight-sided rock ring and charred logs; no animation or detached sparks.

families.name: PokeB_SilverStreetLantern
families.note: Tapered pale-blue diffuser, faceted silver cap and finial, narrow stem, square-reading stepped pedestal.

families.name: PokeC_SilverStreetLantern
families.note: Same silver lantern artwork as poke_b. Reuses its complete geometry and palette under this image folder; not an additional design.

families.name: PokeD_StoneLantern
families.note: Small stone garden lantern: broad rounded cap and finial, open chamber, short feet. Source unlit dark chamber; small warm burner inferred for usable night lighting.

families.name: PokeF_TwinGlobeStreetlight
families.note: Paired low-domed lamps on rising Y arms and one ringed pedestal. Two heads in one complete file.

families.name: PokeG_RoundStreetlight
families.note: Wide low-domed gray head, short pale diffuser band, slender stem and tiered round base.

families.name: PokeJ_DarkStreetLantern
families.note: Small dark lantern left of north house. JPEG obscures detail; inferred faceted cap and small luminous chamber. Existing scale estimate: 24 displayed pixels per tile.

families.name: PokeM_BronzePostLantern
families.note: Visible at lower image edge: bronze pointed hood, broad cream chamber and thin pole. Base and lower stem are cropped away; inferred matching stepped pedestal, total height 48.

families.name: PokeN_TealStreetlight
families.note: Dark teal disc cap, recessed gray-blue diffuser band and flared pedestal. Luminescence inferred from identifiable lamp fixture in daytime source.

families.name: PokeS_IvoryScrollLantern
families.note: Ivory curved shepherd-hook fixture repeated beside waterfalls. Small compressed image: scroll and hanging lantern reconstructed; approx. 10 displayed pixels per tile. Bilateral depth symmetry, intentional offset lantern preserved.
